_meta.description: Performance regression thresholds for the synthetic library harness (Chromium). Update deliberately when intentional changes shift metrics; keep margins for CI noise.
_meta.howToUpdate: Run `npm run build && LIBRARY_BENCHMARK_ITEMS=50000 node scripts/check-library-harness-perf.mjs --record` locally, review the printed metrics, then adjust thresholds with headroom. Do not tighten based on a single fast machine.
notes: Times are wall-clock ms in a headless Chromium browser on vite preview (not native WebKit).
maxActiveThumbnails is a deterministic app bound (CachedThumbnail MAX_CONCURRENT_THUMBNAIL_REQUESTS = 6).
Scan metrics are proxied by first useful screen/query load in the synthetic harness (no real Rust scanner runs).

firstUsefulScreenMs.meaning: initial library grid render (synthetic scan/page load proxy)
